20216.long_desc:
Step up your arcade game with the 19-inch Arcooda Deluxe 5:4 Ratio Arcade LCD Monitor! Experience stunning visuals and unparalleled compatibility with support for 15khz, 24khz, and 31khz signals, up to a crisp 1280x1024 resolution. Perfectly designed for authentic arcade gameplay, this monitor delivers vibrant colors and sharp details, bringing your favorite retro classics to life like never before. Get ready to level up your setup! The features of the new 19inch 5:4 Deluxe Monitor are;
  • RGB, 2xVGA, 2xHDMI, 3.5Audio and a 9ppin Molex Extension port
  • video input support: 15khz, 24khz, 31khz, and up to 1280 x 1024 resolution at low monitor lag
  • custom Arcooda firmware designed specifically for the arcade and amusement industries. Firmware has been designed to be plug and play for as many arcade game boards as possible, including "auto" button to quickly centre your arcade game's picture.
  • extendable monitor adjustment board. Mount inside the monitor frame, or, use the extension to mount at the front of your arcade machine.
  • Audio output support: connect your HDMI input into the Arcooda 19 inch LCD monitor, then connect your 3.5mm audio jack out of the monitor into your audio system.
  • full viewing angle, ideal for arcade games.
  • mounting frame supports VESA (75mm, 100mm @ 8 x M4-12) or use the included mounting brackets to add into your arcade machine.
    • The Arcooda arcade monitor firmware has been refined over many years.
